summary: Shopping-centre REIT concentrated in dense, high-income coastal suburbs, with one of the longest consecutive dividend-increase records in the sector. Its MD&A reconciles net income to Nareit funds from operations and then to two further measures; the Nareit line is the one carried here.

annotations.ffo: The company's own reported figure, read from its 10-K MD&A reconciliation and closing on its printed "Funds from operations (Nareit)" subtotal — not the app's generic Net Income + D&A proxy. FFO is not XBRL-tagged by any REIT checked (a 10-K's label linkbase contains no such element), so the MD&A table is the only source. Each filing is accepted only when its own net-income row agrees with the net income held from XBRL for that year, which verifies the right table, the right scale and the right column alignment together; years that fail are left blank rather than filled from the proxy. The Nareit subtotal, not the two lines below it in the same table (FFO available for common shareholders, after preferred dividends and downREIT/unvested-share amounts, and Core FFO). FY2025 reconciles exactly: 423,648 - 12,571 - 150,111 + 7,425 + 320,311 + 42,671 = 631,373.

caveats: FFO is a full replacement for the derived row, not a merge: a year the reconciliation could not verify is blank rather than falling back to Net Income + D&A, which would change the row's meaning partway across the series.
Company-specific variants in the same table (Core FFO, Normalized FFO, Adjusted FFO, Diluted FFO) are deliberately excluded; only the Nareit subtotal is carried.
